name: Pousada de Lisboa, Praça do Comércio
positioning: Pousada Lisboa Praça do Comércio: a Small Luxury Hotels of the World member in a former royal residence and ministry building on Lisbon's Praça do Comércio, a few metres from the River Tagus
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside a historic building on Lisbon's main riverside square
Couples who want contemporary rooms with an indoor heated pool and massage room for downtime between sightseeing

facts.text: The building is over two centuries old, was erected after the 1755 earthquake, and housed the former Ministry of Internal Administration.
Praça do Comércio, also known as Terreiro do Paço, was the centre of Portugal's royal and administrative power, with monuments such as the Rua Augusta Arch and the Equestrian Statue of King Joseph I.
The pousada is a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World.
Rooms have elegant, contemporary and sophisticated decor.
Molton Brown provides the amenities in all rooms.
Room types range from Cozy to Mezzanine, Superior, Deluxe and Premium, up to the Suite, Suite Áurea, Suite Praça do Comércio and Presidential Suite, some with views of Terreiro do Paço.
The pousada has a discreet indoor swimming pool with heated water, open all year round.
The wellness area has an indoor heated pool, a sauna, a gym and a massage room with treatments by appointment.
The gym has fitness machines, free weights and cardiovascular equipment.
RIB Lisboa specialises in high-quality meats and wines, with seating inside or on a terrace protected by the arches of Praça do Comércio.
The nearest metro station is Terreiro do Paço on the Blue Line, next to Praça do Comércio.

highlights.text: The building was once the residence of kings and headquarters of ministries.
The Great Hall is the former meeting room of the Council of Ministers, with a gilded ceiling restored in detail, and it still has its chandelier.
The pousada has works of art of historical importance provided by the Lisbon Museum.
Pousada Lisboa is in Praça do Comércio, just a few metres from the River Tagus.
Breakfast is served in Pátio Amália, a space with a retractable dome, buffet style with more elaborate à la carte options.

considerations.text: Guest parking is paid public parking nearby.
The wellness area is a discreet indoor heated pool, a sauna, a gym and a massage room with treatments by appointment.
WhataHotel notes the square is a tourist-heavy area with potential crowds.
